flows.name: A coding agent runs on open models served from Europe (Melious)
flows.summary: Melious's home page, in its own terms: an agent or app keeps its OpenAI-compatible client and points it at Melious's base URL; the models (60+ open-weight) are served from European data centres, and Melious offers the agent tools for search, fetch and code execution.

steps.what: Points an existing OpenAI-compatible client, or a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode, at Melious's base URL (a coding subscription or the API).
Sends its model calls (chat, embeddings, reranking) to open-weight models served from European data centres.
Uses Melious's tools for search, fetch and code execution.
